sentences.en: He likes to go out, on the other hand, she prefers staying at home.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢外出，另一方面，她更喜欢待在家里。

sentences.en: On the other hand, some people believe that technology is making us less social.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，有些人认为科技让我们变得更不善于社交了。

sentences.en: I think it's a good idea, on the other hand, my sister disagrees completely.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个好主意，另一方面，我妹妹完全不同意。
